title: From Blood and Ash
author: Jennifer L. Armentrout
summary: A young woman known as the Maiden has been kept veiled, guarded and prepared since childhood for a sacred role she never chose. When a mysterious, dangerous guard is assigned to her, she begins to question everything she has been told.
readIf: you want a steamy, plot-heavy romantasy with secrets, banter and a slow reveal of the world.
skipIf: you dislike cliffhangers, or want a self-contained story, as it sets up a long series.

pairings.reason: A close match for the mood: a heroine, a powerful male lead and a world that slowly opens up.
Another page-turning romantasy with a lot of heat, danger and a clear love interest.
A sharper, more political fantasy with a rival love story and less explicit content.
